live_sources.observed: Second-stage Position/Regular paper submission 2026-10-29 (extended); notification 2026-12-04; camera-ready and registration 2026-12-18. First-stage Regular Paper dates are expired.

Regular and Position tracks, Areas 1/2, English double-blind submission, 10000-50000 non-whitespace characters for Regular Papers, 12-page Full/8-page Short proceedings limits and up to four paid extra pages. Body displays PAPER SUBMISSION WILL BE AVAILABLE SOON.

Double-blind PDF with no author identity or identifying acknowledgments; no simultaneous submission; paper author count should not exceed nine; Regular Paper character and page limits; Full 25-minute oral or Short 20-minute oral/poster presentation; online publication requires presentation.

Any AI-generated text, image, figure or code must be disclosed in Acknowledgments with tool name, affected parts and a short explanation. AI must not fabricate or manipulate research data, code, figures or results; public AI must not generate peer-review text for a manuscript under review.

observed.cancellation: Before 2026-12-22 refund less EUR 100 administrative fee; no refund after that date.

live_sources.observed: AOE means Anywhere on Earth. Camera-ready, copyright, registration and payment must reach the conference by the early-registration deadline. Each accepted paper must be presented; authors register as Speaker. Stage 2 early registration deadline is 2026-12-18 AoE.

Onsite poster A0 portrait and onsite oral procedures; online poster/oral procedures with live presence and backup-video limits. Exact oral/poster and onsite/online assignment is not known before acceptance.
SCITEPRESS MS Word and LaTeX templates are linked; templates are strongly advised for review and mandatory for camera-ready.
The official Submit Paper link resolves to a PRIMORIS login page for ICAART 2027. Authenticated form fields and upload acceptance remain NOT_OBSERVED.

affected_parts: offline analysis and reproduction code used for deterministic checks
ai_disclosure_candidate.text: Generative AI disclosure: OpenAI Codex assisted manuscript organization, English editing and consistency checks in the abstract, related-work framing, interpretation table, discussion, conclusion, acknowledgments and submission materials, and assisted development and revision of offline analysis and reproduction code used for deterministic checks. The authors verified all reported numbers, claims and references against cited artifacts and remain fully responsible for the manuscript. Experimental evidence includes evaluated-system and automated-judge outputs under frozen protocols; deterministic statistics were recomputed with the analysis scripts. These roles are distinct: no AI-assisted review is presented as human blind review, and no AI-assisted adjudication is presented as human semantic gold.
